lessons.title: Reward, Wanting vs. Liking, & The Mesolimbic Dopamine Circuit
lessons.description: Explore motivation neurocircuitry: VTA-to-NAc dopamine, Berridge's wanting vs. liking, Schultz's reward prediction error, and addiction.

lessons.title: Acute vs. Chronic Stress: Cortisol, Neurotoxicity, & The Vulnerable Brain
lessons.description: Examine the SAM vs. HPA axes, allostatic load, glucocorticoid neurotoxicity, hippocampal dendritic atrophy, and amygdalar hyper-reactivity.

lessons.title: Neurobiology of Mental Illness: Neural Circuitry of Depression, Anxiety, & Schizophrenia
lessons.description: Deconstruct psychiatric pathophysiology: monoamine and BDNF models of depression, prefrontal-amygdala decoupling in anxiety, and dopamine/NMDA models of schizophrenia.

lessons.title: Frontiers of Neuroscience: Brain-Computer Interfaces, Optogenetics, & Future Horizons
lessons.description: Discover cutting-edge neurotechnologies: intracortical motor BCIs, closed-loop DBS, neural prosthetics, and the emerging neuroethics of mind decoding.
